author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for TMNT Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants Ninja Edition, an arcade beat 'em up developed by Trailmark Games. Players can soon enjoy an enhanced and improved version of the game on a whole new platform with the Ninja Edition, packed with 60 FPS, HDR support, improved graphics, and more. TMNT Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants Ninja Edition is launching on September 4 for Nintendo Switch 2.

#TMNT #Gaming #IGN
title: TMNT Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants Ninja Edition - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Shadow of the Road gets a new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest Shadow of the Road for this upcoming story-driven turn-based tactical RPG for another look at environments, gameplay, and more. In an alternate 1868 Japan where yokai mythology meets steampunk machinery, Shadow of the Road is a story-driven turn-based tactical RPG about choices that shape your journey, unlikely companions, and a world caught between tradition and progress. Shadow of the Road will be available on PC via Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store on November 12, 2026.
title: Shadow of the Road - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Battle alongside Y'shtola in Final Fantasy Resonance. Watch the latest Final Fantasy Resonance trailer to see Y'shtola in action. Resonate with his Vision within the Sanctum of Light and unleash his abilities in combat. Final Fantasy Resonance will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 22, 2026.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Y'shtola Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape. Watch the creepy new trailer for Name of the Will, an upcoming psychological horror mystery game. Name of the Will will be available on PC in early 2027.
title: Name of the Will - Official Cinematic Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a peek at gameplay and see your objectives in this new 4 Penny Coffins trailer for the upcoming social investigation game. In 4 Penny Coffins, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence in the online multiplayer mode. This social investigation game also includes a solo mode for those brave enough to face the fog alone. 4 Penny Coffins will be available on PC via Steam.
title: 4 Penny Coffins - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the DLSS 4.5 RTX Gameplay Trailer for AION 2, a free-to-play action MMO RPG developed by NCSoft. Players can get a look at the upcoming title with NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 being implemented in the game. Make use of DLSS 4.5 on AION 2, launching into Early Access on September 30 for PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: AION 2 - Official DLSS 4.5 RTX Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Overview Trailer for Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 1, the hit collection of stealth action games developed by Bluepoint Games and Konami. Playera can take a look at the collection, packed with Metal Gear, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake, Metal Gear Solid, Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, and Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater. Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 1 is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 1 - Official Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: PUBG DED.NET is a new first-person shooter from Krafton where you trade flesh for power. In this dog eat dog world, you'll need every advantage to survive and kill the competition. Join the closed beta, coming soon to Xbox Series X/S.
title: PUBG DED.NET - Fresh Meat Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Wolverine Battle Reborn Suit for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, the latest action fighting game developed by ARC System Works. Players can now access a new suit for Wolverine with the latest update inspired by the original design from Insomniac Games' Wolverine game. Suit up in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#MarvelTokonFightingSouls #Wolverine #Gaming
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Wolverine Battle Reborn Suit

author: GameTrailers
description:
Hibi is back for another episode of Star Wars: Galactic Racer - Under the Hood with Hibi, and this time its all about Speeder Bikes. 

This trailer, which was revealed during Xbox's gamescom show, dives deep into one of the options players will have to race when the game launches on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 6, 2026.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer - Official Speeder Bikes Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the 27'' Gaming Monitor Launch Trailer, a new monitor catered to the PlayStation 5 platform developed by Sony. The 27'' Gaming Monitor is packed with a QHD resolution, HDR, VRR Support, and more, with a DualSense wireless charging hook. The 27'' Gaming Monitor is available now.

#PS5 #Gaming #IGN
title: PlayStation 5 - Official 27'' Gaming Monitor Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Gameplay is the star of the latest trailer for Arkheron, the upcoming fast-paced, dynamic, ability-based PvP action game. We also learned Arkheron is coming to console in the Crossplay Beta Test and got a new look at the Eternals Item sets and the 3v3 combat arena and 45-player games modes.
title: Arkheron - Official Gameplay Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
To celebrate 100 years of Lufthansa, Microsoft Flight Simulator is adding the current fleet of Lufthansa to its roster.

This livery package includes a selection of six "meticulously' recreated and authentic Lufthansa liveries, and they will be added to the game in the near future.
title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Official 'Lufthansa Liveries' Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Say hello to Rogue Fortune, an upcoming fast-paced action roguelite where ""greed meets relentless combat, demanding ever more powerful builds and ever greater sacrifice.""

In this world, your wish for eternal riches was granted, but you'll need to do all you can to escape a cursed temple if you ever hope to use it. Rogue Fortune will be released on Xbox Series X/S and PC in 2027.
title: Rogue Fortune - Official Reveal Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Alongside the big news that Militsioner is headed to Xbox Game Pass in 2027, we got a new look at the game where players are being followed by a Colossal Policeman.

It's up to you to anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive, or even romance him in order to escape in this Kafkaesque immersive sim.

Militsioner is headed to Xbox Series X/S and PC in 2027.
title: Militsioner - Official 'Coming to Xbox Game Pass in 2027' Gameplay Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Construct bizarre and improbable things with help from your friends. Explore and build as high as you can in What Goes Up, coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Game Pass in 2026.
title: What Goes Up - Official Announcement Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The time has come to create your own kingdom. Protect your kingdom at night, avoid the plague within the earth, and gather resources within the Rising Realms. Kingdom III: Rising Realms is coming to Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Cloud in 2027, so wishlist now.
title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms - Developer Gameplay Overview Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The team at Bonfire Studios spent some time at gamescom giving players a deep dive into Arkheron, the upcoming fast-paced, dynamic, ability-based PvP action game headed to PC and consoles.

Come learn about what exactly this game is, how combat works, the Eternals Item sets, the 3v3 and 45-player game modes, the Crossplay Beta Test, and much more.
title: Arkheron - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The Chola empire is dying from the inside. As the prince, cast out onto the streets, you must reclaim what is yours and discover what it means to be king. "Can a kingdom be saved by its worst son?" Son of Thanjai comes to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, Cloud, and Game Pass in Spring 2027.
title: Son Of Thanjai - Official Release Window Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Explore the forgotten waters of Nalcott, set sail on your raft, cross uncharted islands, and descend into the deep in this upcoming ocean expansion for Once Human. Watch the Once Human: Isles of Abyss announcement trailer for the upcoming ocean expansion for the free-to-play open-world survival crafting game. The Once Human: Isles of Abyss trailer showcases places you'll explore, gameplay, combat against new foes, and a peek at boss fights you'll take on. Once Human is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, PC, and mobile. The Once Human: Isles of Abyss ocean expansion will be available in October 2026.
title: Once Human: Isles of Abyss - Official Ocean Expansion Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 in this overview trailer for the second installment in the definitive collection of the Metal Gear series. The new trailer shows what to expect from the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, which includes Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version), bonus content, and special features in the collection.

Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#MetalGearSolidMasterCollectionVol2 #Gaming #IGN
title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 - Official Overview Trailer

description:
Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action-adventure game developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will embody an unforgiving assassin on the streets of New York to sell DVDs by day and kill the deserving by night. Get a new look at intense gameplay for Blackwood, launching on September 16 for PC (Steam).

#Blackwood #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Path Tracing & DLSS 4.5 RTX Update Trailer for 007 First Light, the hit third-person action-adventure game developed by IO Interactive. Players can embark on the thrilling story of James Bond's origins in unprecedented fidelity with Path Tracing and DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction coming to the game for the PC platform courtesy of NVIDIA. The Path Tracing & DLSS 4.5 RTX Update launches on September 15 for 007 First Light on PC (Steam), with the game available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia

#007FirstLight #Gaming #IGN
